chunks: From him, from al-Mīthamī, from Abān, from Ismāʿīl ibn al-Faḍl al-Hāshimī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform the maghrib prayer when the sun set, at the point where its disc disappeared.

key_terms.حَاجِبُهَا: its visible edge or upper rim
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: When did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform the maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the time of the maghrib prayer. It indicates that maghrib was performed at sunset, when the visible edge of the sun had disappeared, making it relevant for determining the beginning of the prayer time.
